globalProperty.description: Date format for patientqueueing display and date pickers
A comma separated list of location uuids for locations that clinicians operate from. Must be configured per implementation as location UUIDs differ between distributions.

Person attribute type UUID for phone number lookup during self check-in (e.g., the Telephone Number attribute type). Must be configured per implementation as attribute type UUIDs differ between distributions. Leave empty to disable phone-based lookup.

Comma-separated list of patient identifier type UUIDs to search during self check-in (e.g., Patient ID, National ID). Must be configured per implementation as identifier type UUIDs differ between distributions.
Visit type UUID to use when creating visits for patient self check-in (e.g., OPD visit type UUID). Leave empty to skip visit creation.
Estimated minutes of wait time per person ahead in queue. Used to calculate estimated wait time for self check-in.

UUID of the provider attribute type that maps a provider to a location (attribute value = location UUID). Used by automatic provider assignment to find providers for a location. Leave empty to fall back to matching each provider's user default location instead. If neither is configured, check-in still succeeds and the patient is queued unassigned.
Name of the person attribute type holding a provider's default location UUID, used for provider-location matching when patientqueueing.providerLocationAttributeTypeUuid is not configured.

Whether check-in should automatically assign a provider using the configured assignment strategy. Set to false (or pass autoAssignProvider=false on the request) to always queue patients unassigned for manual assignment from the provider dashboard.
